# Step 8 – Generated Macro Views

## Objective

Generate reusable physical macro views for OpenLane integration.

## Generated Files

- AMUX2_3V_AI.mag – Magic layout
- AMUX2_3V_AI.gds – Final GDSII layout
- AMUX2_3V_AI.lef – LEF abstract
- AMUX2_3V_AI.spice – Extracted SPICE netlist

These files represent the physical implementation of the AI-generated analog multiplexer and are intended for integration into the OpenLane design flow.
